name: Will a new basement door actually stop leaks and drafts?

mainEntity.name: Will a new basement door actually stop leaks and drafts?

acceptedAnswer.text: A door that seals well helps reduce drafts, moisture intrusion, and pest entry, but it will not solve a bigger drainage or foundation problem by itself. In Colorado homes, the surrounding grade, threshold, and sealing details matter as much as the door itself.
acceptedAnswer.description: A new door can improve sealing and reduce leaks or drafts, but it won’t fix a drainage or foundation issue on its own. The opening, threshold, and weatherproofing all have to work together.
